name: Transport Tycoon
description: The logistics builder: draw routes between stations, assign a fleet, feed the schedules, and grow a network whose efficiency score is the scoreboard. This pack composes the squad's vehicle DNA with the library's economy and grid systems into the full loop — routes are a graph over the tile world, cargo is priced by supply and demand, passengers arrive with the sun, vehicles wear out on a maintenance clock, and one public number tells you whether the company is engineering or weather. The design stance: every metric the score consumes is produced by a system the player can inspect, and nothing is ever punished without a visible cause.
loop: build route → assign vehicles → optimize throughput → expand network

signatureCompound.name: Route Profit Loop
signatureCompound.description: The network loop end to end: route_network defines stops, legs, and timetables over pathfinding geometry and flags blocked routes when the world changes, depot_dispatch assigns vehicles to those routes and pulls them for service before they fail, cargo_manifest quotes station prices from supply and demand while passenger_flow fills platforms on the day/night rush, and network_efficiency_score folds on-time rate, load factor, coverage, and profit into the 0-100 number whose milestones unlock the next expansion.
